name: travel-explorer
description: Full-stack travel booking website with React.js, Node.js, and SQLite

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install-all && cd backend && node scripts/seedData.js
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf backend/node_modules && rm -rf frontend/node_modules && rm -rf backend/travel_app.db
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run setup

author: Travel Explorer Team
